title: Binance Options Will Launch BTCUSDT Daily Options
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance Options will launch BTCUSDT Daily Options on  2023-02-02  at  08:00 (UTC).    Please note:   BTCUSDT Daily Options are European-style options contracts. Binance will launch T+2 BTCUSDT Daily Options on  2023-02-02  at  08:00 (UTC) . Thereafter, T+2 BTCUSDT Daily Options will be listed every day at  08:00 (UTC) . Please note that there will be no new T+2 BTCUSDT Daily Options listing if it coincides with the expiration of a BTCUSDT Weekly, Monthly or Quarterly options contract that day. BTCUSDT Daily Options will have a trading lifetime of two days and expire at 08:00 (UTC).  There will be a maximum of two BTCUSDT Daily Options contracts listed at any time.  Please refer to  Binance Options Contract Specifications  for more details.  Where any discrepancy arises between the translated versions and the original English version, the English version shall prevail. Thanks for your support!
